note: BH-6876: the most shard jobs one Harness CI run fans out to. bin/ci-plan-settings.sh projects it into the repo variable CI_MAX_SHARDS, which bin/ci-plan.sh reads as the cap on its time sizing (and on the count rule). A whole number in 1..64; anything else is refused (warn alert ci-plan-settings-sizing:<slug>, the old variable stays). Cost: each shard is one more job, so more shards add job setup minutes (checkout, node, apt), not suite minutes. 12 is the value the operator approved as a repo variable on 2026-10-15 15:05Z (BH-6876 comment 6197071504). The code fallback with no variable is 8.
